_comment: Set account/region, then run 'python deploy/offline_coach.py --config offline_coach.json plan'. Confirm model availability and configure evaluator.model_resource_arns before evaluation. No evaluator role is accepted by the installed CreateEvaluator API. Nothing creates or modifies IAM roles.

evaluator.name: r4_offline_coach_evaluator
evaluator._model_comment: Profile verified in AWS create-evaluator.html and model-card-anthropic-claude-haiku-4-5.html. Before evaluation, configure model_resource_arns with the profile ARN AND every routed foundation-model ARN. Empty list omits judge invocation permissions, not resource creation. Availability/entitlements remain account-dependent.
